overview: In the Signature teaching of mass spectrometry, What Mass Spectrometry Studies is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Ionization means turning neutral molecules into charged ions, by electron impact, ESI, or MALDI. Tandem MS means fragmenting selected ions to read molecular structure piece by piece. Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Foundations material that follows.

Tandem MS: fragmenting selected ions to read molecular structure piece by piece.

vocabulary: m/z: mass-to-charge ratio, the axis of every mass spectrum.
Molecular ion: the intact ionized molecule, giving the molecular weight.
